question: Name the process by which a single cell divides itself into 2 halves?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Binary fission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Binary fission is the process by which a single cell divides itself into 2 halves**__.

 
 
• Binary fission is an asexual reproduction wherein the body separates into two identical bodies.
